container.bleed_rule: Media may bleed to viewport edges while text and controls remain inside the gutter.

two_column.mobile: grid-template-columns: 1fr; stack according to content priority

four_column.mobile: grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) with reduced gap

horizontal_rail.desktop: show all items or use controlled overflow when item count exceeds 5
horizontal_rail.mobile: horizontal scroll with one-and-a-quarter cards visible; never hide the continuation cue

split_hero.desktop: preserve intentional split and product safe area
split_hero.tablet: reduce copy width and retain side-by-side when contrast is sufficient
split_hero.mobile: stack media above copy unless the variant explicitly prioritizes copy-first

asymmetric_hero.desktop: preserve offset grid and overlapping subject
asymmetric_hero.mobile: collapse to a controlled vertical sequence; remove decorative overlap, keep product overlap only when readable

universal_rules: No essential text may be baked into an image.
Maintain a visible keyboard focus state for every interactive element.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion by removing parallax and replacing transitions with opacity or instant state changes.
Touch targets should remain at least 44px in both dimensions.
Product imagery must not be cropped so aggressively that the product identity is lost.
On mobile, primary actions remain visible without requiring hover.
Do not use color alone to communicate sale, availability, error, or selection state.
Text measure should generally remain between 35rem and 48rem for long-form copy.

art_direction.desktop: Prefer 3:2 or 16:9 campaign crops when the composition needs horizontal context.
art_direction.mobile: Provide a dedicated 4:5 or 3:4 crop for product-led imagery rather than relying on a desktop crop.
art_direction.text_safe_area: Reserve at least 38 percent of the image plane for text when the component uses an overlay copy layer.
